response.courseDescription: 529 Dairy Processing Basic dairy chemistry, microbiology, and processing from cow to consumer; dairy quality, safety, and sanitation; milk components, fluid milk, concentrated milk, cream, butter, ice cream, fermented milk, cheese, and dairy powders. Recommended preparation: FS 110 or VIT ENOL 113. Credit not granted for both FS 429 and FS 529. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
